title: 1, 2, or 3 Hours on an E-Bike?
why: Warm fall visitors already considering a Cave Point e-bike rental who need help picking a rental length.
hook_options: 1, 2, or 3 hours? Here's how we'd split it.
Two hours gets you the cliffs and the dunes.
How long should you rent an e-bike at Cave Point?
caption: One hour gets you to the Cave Point cliffs and back. Two hours adds Whitefish Dunes, about 8 to 10 miles total, and it's what we'd book. Three hours is for people who hate watching a clock. Rentals start at our Jacksonport shop. #DoorCounty #CavePoint #WhitefishDunes #EBikeRental

slides.headline: 1, 2, or 3 hours on an e-bike?
slides.body: Here's how we'd split it, starting from the shop in Jacksonport. Our pick is the middle one.

slides.headline: Cave Point and back.
slides.body: Out to the cliffs, a short stop, home again. Good when you're squeezing it between other plans.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Website Ebike Photos/Cave-Point-E-Bike-Rental-with-Fat-Tire-Bike.jpg

slides.headline: Cave Point plus Whitefish Dunes.
slides.body: About 8 to 10 miles total, with time to walk around or eat a picnic. Assist goes off inside the state park.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Website Ebike Photos/Cave-Point-County-Park-Bike-Rental.jpg

slides.headline: No rushing. Side roads welcome.
slides.body: Long stops at the cliffs, a side road or two, a slow ride back. For people who hate watching a clock.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Ebike photos for cave point/door-county-curvy-road-at-cave-point-county-park-e-bike-tour.jpg

slides.headline: Watch the short safety video.
slides.body: It's on the rental page. A few minutes and you know the controls before you touch the bike.

slides.headline: 1 hour: cliffs. 2: add dunes. 3: wander.
slides.body: Can't decide? Take two. That's what we'd book.

slides.kicker: Save this before your fall trip
slides.headline: Two hours. Cliffs and dunes. Done.
slides.body: Rentals book at doorcountykayaktours.com. Share this with whoever's planning your Door County weekend.
